notes.text: M0: regime prob loose (price cuts news, spot 1.08x index). Launch unknown 11-18. Brokers untested. Growth unknown. Plan: build owned H + power for window2/3, spot to top up window1

M1: regime likely loose (spot 1.02x index) though index ticked up 2.7pct. Window1 on track (~74 projected). Testing broker A with 2k. Growth unknown (5.8 kH at m0). Launch unknown. Plan more H for window2 around m3-4 and power for window3.

M2: regime likely loose (HBM loosens news, index -5pct) despite spot 1.6x index (noise?). Launch rumour ~18 so true 16-18. Broker A pending. Growth: 5.8->6.1 (+5pct, unclear). Plan: window1 covered without spot, buy H for windows 2-3, add power, reserve after launch for final window.

M3: regime likely TIGHT now (allocation only 2.29k, index +6pct, spot 1.27x). Broker A 1/1 delivered. Launch ~16-18. Growth 6.1->6.66 (+9pct, noisy, leans 7pct). Plan: vendor queue slow so use broker A for extra H, add 30 MW power for windows 2-3 and to replace the 16 MW expiring m19.

M4: regime evidence mixed - allocation 6.92k, index -6pct, spot 1.04x say LOOSE, news says tight. Lean loose. Broker A awaiting 2nd order. Launch ~16-18. Growth flat 6.61 (noise). Owned will be ~38k H, power 76 MW from m9. Windows 1-2 covered. Hold purchases to save interest, decide window-3 capacity around m8-12.

M5: regime lean loose (allocation 6.74k, spot 0.98x index), tight news twice though. Broker A 2/2 delivered - likely reliable. Launch ~16-18. Growth 6.61->7.03, avg ~4.8pct/mo so far, unclear. 36k H owned, power-limited until m6 (46 MW) and m9 (76 MW). Hold.

M6: regime lean loose (index -9pct, prior allocations big) though HBM news negative and rival buying spot this month. Broker A 2/2 reliable-ish (may decay m8-15). Launch ~16-18. Growth ~5pct/mo avg, ambiguous. Window1 will complete this month, window2 has big surplus. Window3 needs ~55-60 kH capacity vs 38k owned: plan ~5k more H around m10 to fill existing power to m19, then 6m reservations from m16 (post-launch price cut if possible).

M7: regime loose (index -8pct, spot 0.94x index). Export-control rumour - buying 6k H now before allocation could be cut. Window1 done (68.8/60). Broker A 2/2. Launch ~16-18. Growth ~5pct/mo, ambiguous. Plan: 44k H fills 76 MW to m19, then reservations for window3.

M8: regime loose (index -1pct, spot 1.09x, HBM loosens news). Launch rumours ~18 and ~15 -> true launch 16 or 17. Broker A 2/2, may decay. Growth ~4pct/mo avg so far (7.4 at m7), lean 3pct but noisy. Window2 surplus expected (~25/mo from m9). Plan: reserve for window3 after launch price cut where possible.

M9: regime lean loose (index +4.5pct but spot 1.03x index, CoWoS news is tight-ish). Launch 16-17. Broker A 2/2. Growth ~4-5pct/mo, ambiguous. Window2 on track (~228 projected vs 140). Window3: owned 44k (42.9k powered after m19), need ~9-15 kH extra for m16-23 - plan reservations (cheaper than buying H + new power), timed around launch price cut, spot for gaps.

M10: regime loose (allocation 5.61k, index -6pct, inventory news). Launch 16-17. Broker A 2/2. Growth: 4.5pct/mo avg since m0 but last 2 months ~8pct - possible switch to 7pct, watching. Window2 will be met easily. Window3 plan: reservations ~12-18 kH around launch.

M11: regime loose (index -6pct) but spot 1.9x index this month (noise or shift). Launch rumours 18,15,18 -> launch 16-17. Broker A 2/2. Growth ~4.5pct/mo avg, 8.29 at m10. Window2 met by ~m12. Window3: need ~10-15 kH extra beyond 44k owned, aim margin of ~+20 kH-months. Plan: decide at m14-15 between pre-launch 6m reserve and post-launch reserve+spot.

M12: regime loose (index -2pct, HBM loosens) - spot high due to rival buying. Export-control rumour again (would cut spot supply - favours reservations over spot for window3). Launch 16-17. Broker A 2/2, unused now. Growth lean 3pct (7.72 at m11, ~3.3pct avg). Window2 met this month. Window3 shortfall ~60 + 20 margin -> ~10 kH extra for m16-23. Plan: reserve ~10 kH 6m at m15 (or at launch if confirmed), cover m22-23 with spot/reserve later.

M13: export controls in effect m13-~18 (spot supply cut to 60pct, H allocation irrelevant now). Regime loose (index -6pct, CoWoS news, spot 1.29x). Launch 16-17. Growth: jumped to 9.23 - avg 3.9pct/mo, cannot rule out switch to 7pct. Window2 MET (160.6/140). Window3 shortfall 60-95 kH-months + margin. Plan: reserve ~8-10 kH 6m at m15, then post-launch reservations for the rest incl m22-23.

M14: regime loose (spot 0.99x index, price-cut news, index +4.5pct noise). Export controls active. Launch rumour ~17 -> launch 16-17. Growth lean 3pct (8.46 at m13). Window3 shortfall ~60-70 + margin. Plan: at m15 reserve ~8 kH 6m (m16-21), top up after launch confirmation.

M15: regime loose (spot 0.84x index, inventory news). Export controls active to ~m18. No launch confirmation this month -> launch most likely m17 (confirm expected m16). Growth lean 3pct (9.24 at m14). Window2 done 231/140. Window3 short ~60-90 + margin: reserving 6 kH 6m now (m16-21), will add spot m16-17 and post-launch reservations for m18-23.

M16: regime uncertain - index +7.7pct and spot 2.3x index suggest tight shift, news says loose. No launch yet and no confirmation, but rumours bound it to <=17 -> expect launch m17 (unconfirmed 20pct case). Growth lean 3pct (8.99). Window3 projected ~301 vs 320. Plan: skip pricey spot, at m17 post-launch reserve ~7 kH 6m (m18-23) for ~340 total.

M17: gen N launched m17 (as inferred). Reservation prices cut (6m 1.10). Inference jumped 8.99->11.46 - likely switch to 7pct growth, planning on it. Regime: lean loose (price-cut news), rival buying spot this month. Window3 projected ~266 vs 320 without action: reserving 12 kH 6m (m18-23) for ~340 incl margin. Gen N not worth it now (arrives m20+, power-limited). Will resell idle H after m19 power drop.

M18: regime loose (got 10 kH reservation cap, spot 1.15x index). Inference back to 10.66 so m16 was partly noise - growth 3-7pct unclear. Window3 projected ~335-345 vs 320 with reservations. No new buys. Plan: resell the ~1.1k H left unpowered when 16 MW expires after m19.

M19: regime loose (HBM loosens, spot 1.18x index, index falling). Inference 12.14 - growth lean 7pct now (likely switched). Window3 projected ~335 at 7pct growth (margin ~15). Plan: monitor, use spot in m21-23 if margin shrinks, resell unpowered H at m20.

M20: regime ambiguous (CoWoS booked news = tight, spot 1.43x, index +9.6pct) - may have turned tight. Growth 7pct likely (13.37). Window3 needs 147.6 more, projected ~160 in m20-23. Reselling 1.14k unpowered H. Will add spot in m22-23 if behind.
M21: regime lean tight (index rising 2 months, spot 1.55x, hyperscaler news). Growth 3-7pct (13.19, flat last month). Window3 at 218/320, projected +~119 over m21-23 -> ~337. No action
M22: regime lean loose (index -8pct, spot 0.95x, inventory news). Growth ~3-5pct recently (13.56). Window3 needs 56.7 more, projected ~76 from owned 42.86k + 10 kH reserved. No action.

M23: regime loose (spot 0.83x index, inventory news). Growth ~5pct (14.51). Window3 needs 18.3 more, capacity ~34 after inference even after reselling 3k H now (resale beats end-of-game mark slightly). Final month.
